turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, Orion Shield Insurance, Priya speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I'm calling about my wife's car insurance. She wants to cancel it but she's at work, so I said I'd phone. I'm worried about being charged extra.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Ah, that sounds really frustrating. Let's see what we can do. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I just check, are you the policyholder?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, it's my wife's policy. She's at work today so I said I'd call.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you're calling on behalf of your wife about cancelling a car policy. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling on her behalf. I'm sorry, but I can only discuss a policy with the policyholder or a named authorised person. If she calls us directly, or gives consent to add you, we'll be glad to help.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, I understand.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you promise me this won't cost me anything extra?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There's no way you'll be charged anything more, you can count on it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just waive the fee? It seems unfair.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. In general, our policies can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund if no claim has been made, and after that it's a pro-rata refund, meaning the unused part of the premium, less a $25 administration fee.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Right, I see.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. I've logged a note under reference REQ-10390, and our customer service team will contact her to arrange this.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've logged your cancellation request.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
